SELECT r.mail_re_no ,r.mail_receiver ,r.read_check ,FIND_CODENAME(r.read_check) AS read_check_name ,r.mail_no ,m.mail_title AS receive_title ,m.mail_send_date AS receive_date ,m.mail_type ,FIND_CODENAME(m.mail_type) AS mail_type_name ,m.class_id ,m.sender_id ,b.member_name AS sender_name
FROM mail_receivers r join mail m ON(r.mail_no = m.mail_no) join member b ON(m.sender_id = b.member_id)
WHERE m.class_id = #{classId} AND r.mail_receiver = #{mailReceiver}
AND r.mail_receiver != m.sender_id
ORDER BY m.mail_send_date DESC

SELECT r.mail_re_no ,r.mail_receiver ,r.read_check ,FIND_CODENAME(r.read_check) AS read_check_name ,m.class_id ,r.mail_no ,m.mail_title AS receive_title ,m.mail_send_date AS receive_date ,m.mail_type ,FIND_CODENAME(m.mail_type) AS mail_type_name ,m.sender_id ,b.member_name AS sender_name
FROM mail_receivers r join mail m ON(r.mail_no = m.mail_no) join member b ON(m.sender_id = b.member_id)
WHERE m.class_id = #{classId} AND r.mail_receiver = #{mailReceiver}
AND r.mail_receiver = m.sender_id
ORDER BY m.mail_send_date DESC

SELECT r.mail_re_no ,r.mail_receiver ,m.mail_send_date AS receive_date ,FIND_CODENAME(m.mail_type) AS mail_type_name ,m.class_id ,b.member_name AS sender_name ,FIND_CODENAME(b.authority) AS sender_authority
FROM mail_receivers r join mail m ON(r.mail_no = m.mail_no) join member b ON(m.sender_id = b.member_id)
WHERE ROWNUM <= 4 AND m.class_id = #{classId} AND r.mail_receiver = #{mailReceiver} AND r.read_check = 'F201' AND m.mail_type != 'F305'
ORDER BY m.mail_send_date DESC;

SELECT r.mail_receiver ,COUNT(r.read_check) AS new_mail_count
FROM mail_receivers r join mail m ON(r.mail_no = m.mail_no)
WHERE m.class_id = #{classId} AND r.mail_receiver = #{mailReceiver} AND read_check = 'F201' AND m.mail_type != 'F305'
GROUP BY r.mail_receiver
